# Metadata Express

> Metadata Express is a desktop app for creatives: sports photographers, videographers and social teams (Mac and Windows). It imports photos from SD cards, culls RAW files, tags athletes by typing their jersey number, writes Getty-style captions and full IPTC metadata into the photos, and sends them to editors. 14-day free trial; subscription $9.99/month or $99/year.

## What it does

- Import: plug in an SD card or drive and copy photos to the computer, with folder and file names built from variables ({date}, {event}, {seq}), a backup copy, an IPTC template applied while copying, only-locked-photos (camera protect) filtering, Import automatically, and copying only new photos on repeat imports.
- Cull: fast culling of RAW files from every major camera (Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, OM System, Panasonic, Pentax, Leica, Hasselblad, DNG and more) and JPEGs; star ratings and locks from the camera; color labels; favorites and a drives/folders sidebar; drag many photos as one; batch rename with variables.
- Tag (JPEG or RAW): type a jersey number (or short code) and the athlete's exact name from a roster is written as IPTC/XMP keywords and "Person Shown"; tag both teams; rename files with player names.
- Caption: Getty-style captions ("Player of the Team during the A vs. B game at Venue on Date"), optional play-by-play suggestions from an official stats PDF.
- Metadata: full IPTC templates (byline, byline title, credit, source, copyright, usage terms, contact, headline, title, instructions, job ID, categories, location). It only changes the fields you set and keeps existing metadata.
- Rosters: build from a team roster page link (college athletics sites, ESPN, NFL, NBA.com, NHL.com, MLB.com, MLS) or in the app.
- Label Clips (video, in beta): play MXF, MOV and MP4 clips (Sony XAVC, ProRes, DNxHD/HR, H.264, HEVC, XDCAM, AVCHD, GoPro) and rename each one as you watch: a jersey number and Enter puts in the player's last name, your own codes add the play. In / Out and stars exported as a timeline for Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus send, copy and move.
- Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in Metadata Photos and Label Clips.
- Send: deliver photos to editors through Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive (their sync folders) or FTP / FTPS / SFTP, in the background or automatically after importing.
- Works offline; photos never leave the computer except when you send them. A No AI version is available.
